title: King of Glory
lyrics: Lift up your [G]gaze, be lifted up.
Tell every[C2]one how great the love,
The love come [Em7]down from heaven's gate
To kiss the [C2]earth with hope and grace.
Lift up your hands, be lifted up.
Let the redeemed declare the love.
And we bow down at heaven's gate
To kiss the feet of hope and grace.
There is o[C2]ne God; He is [D]holy.
